app.name: Tin Can
app.error.title: Something went wrong
app.error.body: This part of the app stopped working. You can try again, or reload the page.
connect.failed.title: Can't reach the server
connect.failed.body: Check your connection, or ask the person who runs this server whether it is up.
connect.tooNew.title: This app needs an update

setup.title: Set up Tin Can
setup.token.intro: Enter the setup token. `tincan init` printed it, and it is saved in data/setup-token on the server.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.token.mismatch: That token doesn't match. Check the server log for the current one.
setup.token.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
setup.account.intro: You'll be the owner of this server.
setup.community.name: Name
setup.community.hint: Channels arrive in the next version. For now this is just the name people see.
setup.checks.intro: A quick look at whether this server is reachable the way people will use it.
setup.checks.voiceLater: Not set up yet. Voice arrives in a later version.
setup.checks.insecure: This page is not using HTTPS. That is fine for a trial on your own computer, not for a public server.

layout.members.toggle: Show or hide the member list

error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.

channel.create.title: Create a channel
channel.edit.title: Edit channel
channel.name: Name
channel.slowmode.hint: How long each member waits between messages. 0 turns it off. Moderators are not slowed.
channel.category.delete.title: Delete this category?
channel.category.delete.body: Its channels stay, without a category.
channel.delete.title: Delete #{name}?
channel.delete.body: All its messages and files are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
channel.none.title: Nothing here yet
channel.none.body: An admin has not made any channels you can see.
channel.none.admin: Create the first channel to start talking.
channel.pins.empty: Nothing is pinned in this channel.
channel.pick: Pick a channel to edit it or change who can use it.
channel.overwrites: Roles and members with their own rules
channel.overwrites.pick: Pick a role or member to change what they may do in this channel.
channel.overwrites.note: Deny wins over the role's usual rights; Allow wins over a Deny from a less specific rule. Members rank above roles. Server-wide rights cannot be changed here.
channel.overwrites.denied: You need the Manage channels permission to change who can use a channel.
composer.label: Message #{name}
composer.noPermission: You can't send messages in this channel.
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.slowmode: Slowmode: you can send again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
composer.tooLong: {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} too many
composer.fileTooLarge: {name} is larger than the limit of {max}.
composer.quota: You have used up your upload space. Delete some files in Settings → Storage.
message.edit.hint: Enter to save, Esc to cancel
message.delete.title: Delete this message?
message.jumpLatest.mentions: Jump to latest ({count, plural, one {# mention} other {# mentions}})
message.empty.title: This is the start of the channel
link.confirm.title: Open this link?
link.confirm.body: This link goes somewhere other than it shows.
link.confirm.warning: Only open it if you trust the sender.
search.title: Search
search.label: Search messages
search.slowDown: You are searching too fast. Wait a moment.
invite.title: You've been invited to join {name}
invite.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
invite.invalid.title: This invite doesn't work
invite.invalid.body: It has expired or been used up. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
invite.check: Check the fields above and try again.
reset.title: Use a reset code
reset.intro: Your server admin gave you a one-time code.
reset.warning: This signs you out on every other device.
reset.invalid: That code is not valid or has expired.
reset.done.title: Password changed
reset.done.body: You can log in with your new password now.
settings.nickname.hint: Shown instead of your display name in this server.
settings.password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.server.ownerOnly: Only the owner can rename the server.
settings.uploads.maxFile.hint: Applies to the next upload, no restart needed. Files are held in memory while they are checked, so very large limits need a server with the memory for it.
settings.uploads.quota.hint: Total of everything one person has uploaded and not deleted. Raising it helps right away; lowering it never removes files.
settings.uploads.aboveCeiling: The server allows at most {max} MB per file.
notifications.ask: Tin Can can show a notification when someone writes while this tab is in the background.
notifications.on: Notifications are on in this browser.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Change it in your browser's site settings.
storage.nearlyFull: You are close to your limit. Delete files you no longer need.
storage.delete.title: Delete this file?
storage.delete.body: It disappears from the message, which then shows “File removed”. This cannot be undone.
roles.pick: Pick a role to see what it allows.
roles.name: Role name
roles.color.note: The colour shows as a dot next to the role. It never colours anyone's name.
roles.hoist: Show members with this role separately in the member list
roles.everyone.note: @everyone applies to every member. Roles add to it.
roles.delete.title: Delete {name}?
roles.delete.body: Members lose what this role gave them.
members.pick: Pick a member to manage their roles.
members.noRoles: There are no roles to give yet.
members.reset.shown: Send this one-time code to the member. It is shown only now.
perm.VIEW_CHANNEL.hint: See that the channel exists and read it.
perm.READ_HISTORY.hint: See messages from before they opened the channel.
perm.MANAGE_MESSAGES.hint: Delete other people's messages and pin messages.
perm.USE_VOICE_ACTIVITY.hint: If off, they must use push-to-talk.
perm.MOVE_MEMBERS.hint: Move or disconnect others in voice.
perm.MANAGE_CHANNELS.hint: Create, edit and delete channels and categories.
perm.MANAGE_ROLES.hint: Create and edit roles below their own, and give them to others.
perm.MANAGE_INVITES.hint: See and revoke other people's invites.
perm.VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.hint: Read the log of admin actions.
perm.MANAGE_INSTANCE.hint: Server name and settings, password reset codes.
perm.ADMINISTRATOR.hint: Everything, and ignores channel rules. Hand out with care.

voice.notice.joined_elsewhere: You joined from another device, so this one left the call.
voice.notice.removed: You were removed from the call.
voice.notice.permission_lost: You no longer have permission to be in this voice channel.
voice.notice.offline: Voice is offline right now. Text chat still works.
voice.notice.mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. You can listen, but others cannot hear you. Allow it in your browser and rejoin.
voice.notice.mic_missing: No microphone found. You can listen, but others cannot hear you.
voice.notice.denoiser_downgraded: Noise suppression was switched to the browser’s built-in one to save CPU.
voice.notice.disconnected: The connection to the voice server was lost.
voice.call.title: {name} · {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
voice.call.notVoice: This is not a voice channel.
voice.pane.title: Voice & audio
voice.pane.outputUnsupported: Your browser cannot choose an output device; it uses the system default.
voice.preset.standard.hint: Best for most people. Removes background noise and evens out your level.
voice.preset.aggressive.hint: For noisy rooms, fans and loud keyboards. A noise gate also cuts the gaps between words.
voice.preset.natural.hint: For quiet rooms and good microphones. Lightest processing.
voice.preset.studio.hint: Echo cancellation and noise suppression are off. Use headphones, or other people will hear themselves.
voice.preset.custom.hint: Your own mix of the advanced settings.
voice.pane.pttWebNote: Push to talk works only while this tab is focused. In games, use voice activity and a mute shortcut.
voice.pane.micTestNote: The recording stays in this tab and is discarded when you leave this page.
voice.pane.micError: The microphone could not be opened: {reason}
voice.test.title: Test connection
voice.test.intro: Checks whether voice can reach this server from your network.
voice.test.summary.udp: Voice works over a direct connection.
voice.test.summary.tcp: Your network blocks the direct path, so Tin Can uses a backup connection. Calls work with a little more delay.
voice.test.summary.relay: Your network blocks direct and backup paths, so Tin Can uses the relay. Calls work with more delay. This is common on school and work networks.
voice.test.summary.none: Tin Can cannot reach the voice server from this network, so voice will not work here. Text chat still works. Try another network, or send the diagnostics to your server admin.
voice.test.summary.off: Voice is not set up on this server.
